{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
df_qa = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Check if any QA orders are in the loyal + completed group
loyal_completed_qa = df_qa[(df_qa['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_qa['status'] == 'completed')]

# Print the number of QA orders in the loyal+completed group
print(len(loyal_completed_qa))

# Print the revenue value of the QA order(s) to confirm it's 999999.99
print(loyal_completed_qa['revenue_clean'].values)

# Filter out QA orders from the loyal+completed group
loyal_completed_clean = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                            (df['status'] == 'completed') & 
                            (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Print the number of valid orders after removing QA
print(len(loyal_completed_clean))

# Compute mean revenue after removing QA orders
mean_revenue_clean = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(mean_revenue_clean)"}
